description: The **solidforge** Claude Code plugin — a Loop Engineering system for AI coding agents. Bundles the specify->implement convergence loop: the blueprint-crafting skill (produce convergence-checked upstream artifacts — PRD / arch-design / iteration-plan / research) and the parallel-development skill (implement via a dual-ring convergence loop), their 13 cascaded subagents (registered as solidforge:<name>), and the deterministic convergence-loop hooks (fast-gate, blueprint read-only guard, breaker counters, architecture-contract gates). Integrates external skills as invoked engines under an artifact+invocation contract (engines-not-reimplement) — four advisory convergence-point rule gates: Impeccable (frontend design governance — DESIGN.md frozen anchor + 44-rule design-fidelity detector + /impeccable critique), Spectral (OpenAPI spec ruleset compliance + Depth-2 frozen-spec anchor; complementary to arch-contract-api), Semgrep (source SAST; complementary to /security-review + arch-contract-deps), and Vale (docs prose quality). These four are the rule axis (design / spec / source-SAST / prose) the first-party structure + language gates do not cover. Loads as a Claude Code plugin (.claude-plugin/plugin.json; skills/, agents/, hooks/hooks.json, commands/; this dev workspace via the ~/.claude/skills/solidforge symlink); Layer 1 (enable) activates skills + agents + hooks, Layer 2 (/solidforge:arm-tools) provisions per-project arch-configs + gate dev-deps + constitution. Domain concepts: Claude Code plugin model, scoped agent refs, deterministic inner-ring gates vs adversarial outer-ring review (plan-reviewer), convergence-repair loop, self-checking infra, external-skill integration (artifact+invocation contract), design governance (DESIGN.md / design-fidelity gate), rule-axis advisory gates (Spectral OpenAPI / Semgrep SAST / Vale prose), design decisions / ADRs, agent-oriented writing.
